cohort: 588 singleton pregnancies diagnosed with polyhydramnios upon admission to labor between 2003 and 2013, matched 1:1 with controls having normal amniotic fluid index (AFI)
finding: Polyhydramnios was found to be an independent risk factor for delivery by cesarean section.
mod_finding: The incidences of both non-laboring cesarean and intrapartum operative deliveries were significantly higher among women with polyhydramnios compared to the controls.
